title: Data Scientist - Digital, Python, R
text: Data Scientist - Digital, Python, R at Evolution Recruitment Solutions Pty Ltd (Sydney, Parramatta & Western Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Company and Culture This Australian product based business is a partner and supplier to some of the biggest brand names in the services and finance industry. The company prides itself on growing its product base to achieve innovation and a competitive advantage. This company is progressive and forward-thinking, pushing technology and is in the midst of a digital transformation. It has an engaging culture, with a large focus on the wellbeing of its team members. As a result of strong growth and an internal move, an opportunity has arisen for a Data Scientist with a digital inclined background and focus, looking be a pivotal member of this collaborative and creative culture. Opportunity As a Data Scientist, your responsibilities and learning will include: Partnering with world-class business leaders, tech leaders and experts to drive business performance and create deep insights Solve business problems and identify opportunities, influence key decisions through your findings and tools Build innovative data products - ranging from customer segmentation, predictive modelling, statistical modelling and utilising machine learning techniques and algorithms Build and develop analytical solutions for the wider business Build reports, APIs and bidding tools Collaborate with engineers, tech specialists, product owners and senior stakeholders Drive continuous improvement of tools, solutions and strategies. Skills and Experience Bachelor, Master or PhD in the areas of Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Data Science or related areas Extensive experience with statistical modelling, machine learning Extensive experience with programming languages such as R and Python Some experience working within the digital space would be advantageous Some experience with SQL for data querying, BigQuery Mindset of continuous self-development and curiosity. What's in it for you? Excellent salary and benefits Work on interesting projects Flexible working arrangements and weekly benefits This is a rare opportunity to play a pivotal role in a market leader in Australia Learn from some of business and tech's most influential people. Apply If you tick the boxes and you are interested in the role, click Apply Now or email Peter Duong at peter.duong@evolutionjobs.com.au, quoting reference PD660014 Even if this role isn't perfect for you, I specialise in the Data Science market and have numerous other opportunities available that I would love to discuss with you.
